description: File a decision card ("Vorschlag") for a human on the page Vorbereitet — for any tenant, any topic (mail triage, invoices, follow-ups, …). The person sees title, area, sources, process step, the mail draft (editable) and your answer buttons; NOTHING is sent or changed before their explicit answer. Required: titel, bereich (free text, used for grouping, e.g. 'Posteingang'). Optional: objekt_typ + objekt_id (lead|account|contact|email|todo|deal|offer|project|… — checked against the tenant), schluessel_extern (idempotency key, e.g. the email id: the same key returns the same card and updates it while still open; decided cards are left alone), workflow_id + knoten_id (node id or schluessel; the card counts on that node in the flowchart, the process step is filled from the node), an_user_id (who decides; default the person behind your key), vorschlag {schritte?:[text], frage?, antworten?:[{text, aktion}], quellen?:[{label, url? (https or /app/…), text?}], prozess?:{workflow, schritt, aktion?, wer_heute?:{mensch, code, ki}, heute?:{mensch, code, ki}}, wichtigkeit?(0-100)}, entwurf {mail?:{to, subject, body, attachments?:[document_id], from?}, text?, dokument_id?}. Answer actions: mail_senden (sends exactly the approved mail as the deciding person), nichts | ablegen (just closes), any other word (e.g. termin_eintragen) or a free-text answer → a task back to YOU (the creating agent) with the card and the answer; report the result with set_vorbereitung. 'Nein' and 'Anpassen' are always offered. Default buttons: with a mail 'Freigeben und senden', else 'Erledigt – ablegen' — with sprache 'en' (for English-speaking tenants) 'Approve and send' / 'Done – file away' and an English default question. Limits per tenant: 200 open agent cards, 150 new per hour. CONTENT GOES INTO vorschlag/entwurf with exactly these field names — the card must carry at least one of vorschlag.schritte, vorschlag.antworten, vorschlag.quellen or entwurf (otherwise rejected as an empty card). Own data (machine, prices, open points …) as readable lines in vorschlag.schritte or as quellen [{label, text}] — other fields inside vorschlag/entwurf and unknown arguments are rejected. Accepted shortcuts (the result lists them under angeglichen): schritte/frage/antworten/quellen/prozess/wichtigkeit at top level, mail/text/dokument_id at top level, beschreibung → entwurf.text, knoten → knoten_id, antworten as plain strings (→ {text, aktion}; 'Erledigt – ablegen'-like → nichts), quellen as plain strings (→ {label}), entwurf {an, betreff, text} → entwurf.mail. Example: {"titel":"Angebot Beispiel GmbH freigeben","bereich":"Angebot","vorschlag":{"schritte":["Preis 10.000 EUR netto (18 Positionen)","Offen: Kollisionspruefung OP30"],"frage":"Angebot so an Beispiel GmbH senden?","antworten":[{"text":"Freigeben und senden","aktion":"mail_senden"},{"text":"Erst OP30 pruefen","aktion":"op30_pruefen"}],"quellen":[{"label":"Kalkulation 2026","text":"18 Positionen, Summe 10.000 EUR"}]},"entwurf":{"mail":{"to":"einkauf@example.com","subject":"Ihr Angebot","body":"Guten Tag …"}}}

bereich.description: Free-text area used for grouping cards (e.g. 'Posteingang')

entwurf.description: {mail?: {to, subject, body, attachments?, from?}, text?, dokument_id?}

mail.description: Mail draft: {to, subject, body, attachments?, from?}

text.description: Draft text or result shown on the card

objekt_typ.description: Type of the related object (e.g. lead, email, deal); with objekt_id

schluessel_extern.description: Idempotency key (e.g. the email ID); same key updates the open card

vorschlag.description: Card content: schritte (lines the human reads), frage, antworten (buttons), quellen, prozess, wichtigkeit. No other fields.

antworten.description: [{text, aktion}] — aktion: mail_senden | ablegen | nichts | own word (task back to you)

frage.description: Question shown to the person deciding

prozess.description: Process step: {workflow, schritt, aktion?, wer_heute?, heute?}

schritte.description: Readable lines with the proposed steps or own data

name: create_vorschlag
